claims.text: The hotel is in SoMa, near Moscone Center and SFMOMA.

findings.quote: Located in SoMa, our hotel is near Moscone Center, SFMOMA and other San Francisco must-sees

claims.text: The hotel is close to downtown sights such as Union Square and Oracle Park.

findings.quote: a hotel steps from downtown must-sees like Union Square, Fisherman's Wharf and Oracle Park

claims.text: Each room has a signature W Hotels Bed with a pillow-top mattress, bedside tech hookups and a W Mix Bar.

findings.quote: Each renovated room features a signature W Hotels Bed with pillow-top mattress, ergonomic work spaces, Wi-Fi access, bedside tech hookups, and W Mix Bar for a little play.

claims.text: Rooms and suites are designed around San Francisco's gold mining history.

findings.quote: inspired by San Francisco's history of gold mining and the art of searching for fortune

claims.text: The Premier Terrace has space to lounge and overhead heat lamps.

findings.quote: Make yourself at home with ample space to lounge, plus overhead heat lamps to keep you warm and cozy 24/7.

claims.text: Many two-room suites have a living room and one or two bathrooms with Davines amenities.

findings.quote: Many feature a luxe living room and one or two bathrooms with Davines amenities.

claims.text: Rooms have goose-down duvets and a pillow menu.

findings.quote: The rooms feature pillow-top mattresses with 350 thread count linens, goose-down duvets, and a menu of pillows.

claims.text: The FIT gym's machines are circled under a massive skylight.

findings.quote: Machines are circled up under a massive skylight, while a central seating area is lit by rings of colored fixtures, and the tunes are piped in.

claims.text: The Living Room Bar is a lively space with vibrant lights and music.

findings.quote: Sip, sample and socialize in the Living Room Bar, an intoxicating space with vibrant lights, pulsating tunes and heavenly hues.

claims.text: The hotel's Whatever/Whenever service handles guest requests at any hour.

findings.quote: With our Whatever/Whenever® Service, we've got you covered. Whatever you want. Whenever you want it. Just ask.

claims.text: Pets are welcome, and dogs and cats receive a W Hotels pet bed and bowls on arrival.

findings.quote: Pets are welcome at W San Francisco, and upon arrival your dog or cat will receive: a custom W Hotels pet bed, food and water bowl with floor mat

claims.text: The Premier Terrace rooms have a beveled tent structure for an indoor-outdoor glamping experience.

findings.quote: Pan for gold in the beveled tent structure to expand your accommodations with an indoor / outdoor glamping experience.

claims.text: The hotel keeps bees on its 31st-floor rooftop, and their honey goes into cocktails.

findings.quote: Get buzzed on a honey infused cocktail and culinary experience remixed by our bees that have been colonized on the 31st floor rooftop since November 2011.

claims.text: The hotel was the first existing building in North America to receive LEED-EB Platinum certification.

findings.quote: W San Francisco is proud to be the first existing building in North America and the 11th in the world to receive LEED-EB Platinum certification.

claims.text: Rooms and suites have sweeping views of downtown San Francisco.

findings.quote: Hotel rooms and suites boast sweeping downtown San Francisco views

claims.text: The lobby has a black check-in desk that glows pink and purple beneath a light-up map of San Francisco.

findings.quote: the ultra-modern decor lights up, from the black check-in desk that glows pink and purple to the light-up map of San Francisco above it, as well as the LED lights embedded in the bar.

claims.text: A daily destination fee is charged; it includes a food and beverage credit, SFMOMA tickets, e-bike rentals and enhanced internet.

findings.quote: A daily destination fee of $30 plus tax will be charged to your folio.
The daily destination fee includes a daily $25 beverage and food credit, two SFMOMA tickets (per stay), e-bike rentals (2 max per day), and daily enhanced high-speed internet access.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may be busy for some guests.
